boundary: THEOREM: a fixed-point-free order-3 isometry with char poly Phi_3^k on an even unimodular lattice of rank 2k yields a nondegenerate ALTERNATING form on F_3^k, i.e. W(k-1,3) -- proved algebraically, controlled against E8 where it reproduces the independently-found W(3,3). For Leech this gives W(11,3), six qutrits. EXHAUSTIVE from the 2.Co1 character table: no Phi_9^4 class exists, so the qutrit branch stops one rung above W(3,3), W(3,3)

e8_control.agrees_with: Pass 7217, which built the E8 fibration explicitly

leech.element: classical: the complex Leech structure, Aut = 6.Suz, already recorded at analysis/w33_complex_leech_suzuki_chain.py
leech.note: this is a rung the Pass 7351 uniformity filter wrongly deleted

no_phi9_fourth.consequence: the qutrit branch stops at six qutrits; W(3,3), W(3,3), is the rung below and Co0 does not supply the element
no_phi9_fourth.method: exhaustive over classes from the 2.Co1 character table, decoding (a,b,c) from chi(1)=a+2b+6c=24, chi(g)=a-b, chi(g^3)=a+2b-3c
no_phi9_fourth.upgrades: the Pass 7343 census, from an enumeration to a theorem

not_done: an explicit omega in the Co0 basis

rejected.failed: does not preserve the invariant Gram, so it is not an isometry
rejected.had: order 3, minimal polynomial Phi_3, trace -12, det(I-W) = 3^12

theorem.conclusion: nondegenerate alternating on F_3^k, i.e. W(k-1,3)
theorem.hypothesis: L even unimodular of rank 2k with Gram G; w an isometry of order 3 with char poly Phi_3^k
theorem.step_a: w^2+w+I=0 gives (I-w)(w+2I)=3I, so P:=w+2I is exactly 3(I-w)^-1
theorem.step_c: F:=P^T G has F+F^T = G(w+w^2)+4G = 3G = 0 mod 3, so F is antisymmetric; 2F_ii=0 with 2 a unit forces zero diagonal
theorem.step_d: mod 3, F = G(w^2-I) with w^2-I=(w-I)(w+I) and w+I=-w^2 invertible, so rank F = rank(w-I) = k exactly

qubit.stops_because: ARITHMETIC: a fourth rung needs Phi_16^3, giving odd-dimensional F_2^3 where every alternating form is degenerate; 24 = 8*3 with 3 odd

qutrit.stops_because: GROUP-THEORETIC: the arithmetic admits Phi_9^4 (24 = 6*4, quotient F_3^4 = W(3,3)) and Co0 has no such class

two_branches.which_lattice_reaches_W33: W(3,3) is reachable from E8 (Pass 7217, reproduced here as the control) and NOT from Leech

why_no_matrix.atlas: no 24-dimensional integral representation of 6.Suz exists; only p196560 and 12-dimensional reps over F7, F13, F25
why_no_matrix.maxes_route: maxes-2 derived subgroup gave an integral W with W^3=I, W^2+W+I=0, trace -12, det(I-W)=3^12 -- but NOT an isometry of the Gram, so it is not omega and was rejected
why_no_matrix.maxes_sweep: maxes 1-8 yielded no fixed-point-free order-3 isometry
why_no_matrix.random_search: 4000 words gave 1679 order-3 elements with traces only -3 and 0; the fixed-point-free class has trace -12 and centraliser 6.Suz, so density ~1/2.7e12 -- unreachable, and reported as unreachable rather than absent
